status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY RESULT WAS COMPUTED
claim_under_test: POOLING-dilution's deployable half (from wiki/innovate_sweep_2026-09-10.md): restricting the representation to candidate CAUSAL loci before pooling recovers within-lineage signal that whole-genome mean-pooling destroys.
why_this_bar_is_registered_after_a_mecha: This repo has TWO recorded cases of a bar frozen too early: one used a NET count to police a DIRECTIONAL failure mode, and one froze '+4 hits' from an un-analysed actionable set, making it unachievable by construction. Both share a root cause -- the number was fixed before the analysis that bounds what a correct result can look like.

So the substrate was measured FIRST and only then was this written: 123 strains resolve cleanly (60R / 63S) across 71 MLST lineages, after dropping 1 duplicate assembly and refusing 16 strains whose QRDR set does not resolve unambiguously.
Freezing early prevents tuning to the result; it does not excuse freezing a number with no basis.

arms.whole_genome_pooled: mean-pool over ALL ~4,900 cached genes per strain -- the representation shape used by all five de-confounded failures
arms.qrdr_restricted: mean-pool over exactly 4 genes (gyrA, gyrB, parC, parE)
arms.random_4gene_null: 50 draws of 4 genes sampled from the intersection of all strains' cache keys, same strains, same CV

dimensionality_is_held_constant: both arms mean-pool to the same 512 dims, so any difference cannot be a dimensionality artifact

verdict_rule.SUPPORTED: auroc_qrdr > auroc_whole_genome AND auroc_qrdr > max(random_4gene_null). BOTH required.
verdict_rule.REFUTED_LOCUS_IDENTITY: auroc_qrdr > auroc_whole_genome BUT auroc_qrdr <= max(random_4gene_null) -- narrowing helps, locus IDENTITY does not. This REFUTES the deployable claim while leaving the dilution mechanism partly intact, and it must be reported as a refutation of what was claimed, not as a partial win.
verdict_rule.FALSIFIED: auroc_qrdr <= auroc_whole_genome -- the prediction fails outright.
verdict_rule.INDETERMINATE: either arm returns no AUROC (insufficient scored folds).

why_max_and_not_a_p_value: The null's MAXIMUM over 50 draws is the conservative reading and is the same standard used for the 2026-09-05 MLST purity result in this repo. Strains within a lineage are clonal, so a per-strain p-value would assume independence the data does not have.
declared_in_advance: The QRDR arm carries prior knowledge (which 4 genes matter for ciprofloxacin) that the whole-genome arm would have to discover unaided. That asymmetry IS the hypothesis -- locus resolution -- and is not a confound to be corrected away, but it bounds the claim: this tests whether a CAUSAL-LOCUS representation beats a pooled one, NOT whether a model can find those loci by itself.

A SUPPORTED verdict would NOT reopen the natural-population zero-shot negative. It would say the representation, not the population design, is what the five failures had in common -- a claim about REPRESENTATION, and one that still needs the constructed-cross test to separate the two axes.

No threshold is set on the SIZE of any gap. The rule is ordinal on purpose: with 123 strains and 71 lineages there is no basis in this repo for asserting a minimum effect size, and inventing one would repeat the '+4 hits' error.
